title: The 100th Day of School: What Teamwork Can Build!

lines.text: Celebration time! The whole elementary school is cheering for the one hundredth day!
lines.caps: Celebration *TIME! | The whole school is cheering for the *ONE HUNDREDTH | *DAY!

lines.text: Teacher announces: Each table has five minutes to stack one hundred foam blocks!
lines.caps: Teacher announces: Stack *ONE HUNDRED | blocks before the recess bell *RINGS!

lines.text: At first, everyone scrambled and grabbed blocks, knocking each other's towers over!
lines.caps: At first, everyone *SCRAMBLED, | knocking each other's towers *OVER!

lines.text: Leo called a timeout: If we fight for blocks, nobody wins the trophy!
lines.caps: Leo called a *TIMEOUT: | If we fight for blocks, nobody *WINS!

lines.text: Mia, you hand the blocks! Sam, steady the wide base! I will place the spire!
lines.caps: Mia, hand the *BLOCKS! | Sam, steady the base! I'll place the *TOP!

lines.text: Block by block, ten, twenty, fifty, eighty—rising taller than their teacher!
lines.caps: Block by block, twenty, *FIFTY, | eighty—rising taller than their *TEACHER!

lines.text: Ninety-nine, ONE HUNDRED! Just as the bell chimed, the golden star crown sat on top!
lines.caps: Ninety-nine, *ONE HUNDRED! | The golden star sat *RIGHT ON TOP!

lines.text: Teamwork divides the difficult task and multiplies the celebration ten times over!
lines.caps: Teamwork divides the *TASK | and multiplies the celebration *TEN TIMES | *OVER!

lines.text: Celebrate winning together—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
